description: Self-hosted Renovate global config (agent-lcars#2018) for the fleet
repos the hosted Mend/Renovate app does not cover:
`.github/workflows/renovate-self-hosted.yml` runs
renovatebot/github-action against exactly the repos listed below,
authenticating per owner as the `agent-lcars` GitHub App instead of the
hosted app (which would need an `admin:org` credential nobody on this
fleet holds). See docs/renovate.md for the full hosted-vs-self-hosted
split, and for how to add or remove a repo here -- this `repositories`
array is the single source of truth the workflow's matrix is computed
from.
Every repo below already carries its own merged renovate.json extending
`github>jlapenna/agent-lcars//renovate-preset` (requireConfig enforces
that rather than silently onboarding a repo with none).
Deliberately does not repeat platformAutomerge or a major-update
packageRule here: every repo below already inherits both from the
shared preset via its own `extends`, and Renovate resolves a
repository's own config (including everything it pulls in via
`extends`) after this global config and lets the later match win
field-by-field -- so a rule placed only here could be silently
overridden by a future repo-level packageRule, while one in the shared
preset can't be outranked by anything that merely extends it. See
renovate-preset.json's own major-update packageRule for the actual
rule and the auto-merge hazard it guards against.

Renovate publishes its internal gates as commit statuses (POST /repos/:o/:r/statuses). The fleet App has no `statuses` permission, so that call returns 403 'Resource not accessible by integration' and Renovate aborts the whole repository with result=integration-unauthorized right after pushing the branch -- branches appeared with no PRs (run 35542549491, agent-lcars#2018). Setting each name to null skips publishing the status; the gates themselves still run, so the preset's npm minimumReleaseAge of 1 day is still enforced, it just is not shown as a check. The hosted-app repos are unaffected and keep their statuses, which is why this lives here and not in renovate-preset.json.
